findings.summary: At 4 years, the only number on screen (25,725) belongs to the comparison account and could easily be taken as the fund's result.
For self-employed users there's no number before 6 years, only an orange note, which is exactly when they'd want to know how much they lose.
The calculator opens on salaried (שכירים) by default, and the self-employed (עצמאים) option is easy to miss.
The 8-year breakdown chart has many columns and colours, and labels like 'החזר המס הוסיף' and 'המס לקח 0' aren't explained next to them.
It's not clear whether 68,853 is in today's money; the line only says 'after the tax refund'.
